Feature.Description:
A SiLA Server for controlling the Microplate Centrifuge made by Agilent Technologies.
The Microplate Centrifuge is a compact automated centrifuge with robotic access. It has an optional plate loader that transfers the microplate into the specified bucket in the centrifuge. Model number: G5582A Product URL : https://www.chem-agilent.com/contents.php?id=1006103
VWorks ActiveX Control (version 13.1.9.1493) is required on the computer running this SiLA Server. The Microplate Centrifuge has optional plate loader. This server assume that the plate loader is installed on the Microplate Centrifuge.

Command.Description:
Open the door to specified bucket. If you call this command while another observable command is running, the request will be rejected.
Calling this command invokes the instrument command OpenDoor.
Status required to execute this command: Idle Status while this command is running: Running Status after this command finishes If it completes normally: Idle If an error occurs: Error

Parameter.Description: The bucket number to be presented.

Command.Description:
Close the door. If you call this command while another observable command is running, the request will be rejected.
Calling this command invokes the instrument command CloseDoor.
Status required to execute this command: Idle Status while this command is running: Running Status after this command finishes If it completes normally: Idle If an error occurs: Error

Run a spin cycle with or without the Centrifuge Loader.
When Using the Loader: - Set BucketNumberToLoad and BucketNumberToUnload to 1 or 2.
When Not Using the Loader: - Set BucketNumberToLoad to 0 - Set BucketNumberToUnload to 1 or 2, based on the desired bucket to present after the spin completes. In this case, the following parameters are ignored: - GripperOffsetToLoad - GripperOffsetToUnload - PlateHeightToLoad - PlateHeightToUnload - SpeedToLoad - SpeedToUnload - OptionsToLoad - OptionsToUnload
If you call this command while another observable command is running, the request will be rejected.
Calling this command invokes the instrument command SpinCycle.
Status required to execute this command: Idle Status while this command is running: Running Status after this command finishes If it completes normally: Idle If an error occurs: Error

Parameter.Description: Percentage of maximum velocity for spinning the Microplate Centrifuge.
Percentage of maximum acceleration for spinning the Microplate Centrifuge.
Percentage of maximum deceleration for spinning the Microplate Centrifuge.

Specify how the value entered in the Time parameter should be used for spinning. 0: total time (including acceleration and deceleration time) 1: duration of spinning at the target speed (excluding acceleration and deceleration time)
Number of seconds to spin.
The number of the Microplate Centrifuge bucket to load with a plate. If you set 0, loading/unloading is not executed, just spin the Microplate Centrifuge.
The number of the Microplate Centrifuge bucket to unload a plate. If you set 0 to BucketNumberToLoad (= no bucket is loaded), BucketNumberToUnload indicates which bucket to present after the spin.
Specifies the distance (mm) from the plate bottom to the gripping point of the gripper center during loading. The default gripper offset is 8 mm.
Specifies the distance (mm) from the plate bottom to the gripping point of the gripper center during unloading. The default gripper offset is 8 mm.
The height of the plate to load. The default plate height is 15 mm.
The height of the plate to unload. The default plate height is 15 mm.
The speed at which the Centrifuge Loader should move during the loading process. 0: slow 1: medium 2: fast
The speed at which the Centrifuge Loader should move during the unloading process. 0: slow 1: medium 2: fast

Options for loading plate.
0: No options set 1: Ignore plate sensor 2: Grip plates gently 3: Ignore plate sensor and grip plates gently 4: Assume maximum plate height 5: Assume maximum plate height and Ignore plate sensor 6: Assume maximum plate height and Grip plates gently 7: Use all options
The options should be applied during the loading process. If the assume maximum plate height option is used, the PlateHeightToLoad parameter is ignored.

Options for unloading plate.
0: No options set 1: Ignore plate sensor 2: Grip plates gently 3: Ignore plate sensor and grip plates gently 4: Assume maximum plate height 5: Assume maximum plate height and Ignore plate sensor 6: Assume maximum plate height and Grip plates gently 7: Use all options
The options should be applied during the unloading process. If the assume maximum plate height option is used, the PlateHeightToUnload parameter is ignored.

Command.Description:
Terminate the spin cycle currently in progress and open the door to specified bucket. The following notes apply to this command: * The loader does not unload the plate after the door opens, so it is necessary to call the UnloadPlate command. * After this command is called, the instrument status immediately becomes Idle, but the spin continues for a while. There is no command or property to confirm whether the stop process has actually completed. If you want to detect whether the spin has fully stopped, verify the instrument's physical state.
Calling this command invokes the instrument command StopSpinCycle.
Status required to execute this command: Running Status while this command is running: Same as the status at the start of execution Status after this command finishes If it completes normally: Idle If an error occurs: Error

Parameter.Description: The bucket number to be presented.
